chunks: Likewise, whatever was in Hāʾ from Ḥarīz ibn ʿAbd Allāh, I have transmitted it through this chain of transmission.

key_terms.بِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ: through this same chain of transmission
key_terms.حَرِيزِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: the transmitter from whom these reports are narrated

ai.seo_question: Through which sanad/isnad are the narrations from Ḥarīz ibn ʿAbd Allāh transmitted in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage states that the reports in this section attributed to Ḥarīz ibn ʿAbd Allāh are transmitted through the same previously mentioned sanad/isnad (chain of narrators). Its significance lies in documenting the route of transmission for hadith and preserving scholarly precision in attribution.
